curation.name: Microduck Running
curation.summary: Fast forward-running policy for Microduck, trained for flat ground at commands up to 2.2 m/s.
curation.details: The public package is designed primarily for forward speed; its published command and simulation observations are not a hard hardware speed limit.
curation.notes: The package manifest is resolved and inspected; no independent hardware evidence is recorded.

publisher_hardware.note: The publisher reports simulation evaluation and no physical Microduck deployment evidence.
